description: Scan a list of existing debts and find, for EACH debt, the best qualifying market refinance offer. Returns a ranked "savings stack" with monthly and lifetime savings (net of typical closing costs) per debt plus whether refinancing is worth it, and overall totals. Use this to find refinance opportunities across a borrower's whole debt portfolio.

credit_score.description: Borrower's credit score (300-850). Recommended for accurate matching.

debts.description: List of existing debts to evaluate for refinancing.

current_rate.description: Current interest rate as a percentage (e.g., 7.9).

state.description: US state code (2-letter, e.g., TX). Required.

name: scan_savings

stack.description: The user's debts ordered by refinancing opportunity, biggest saving first.

balance.description: Outstanding balance in dollars on this debt.

best_offer.description: Best live published replacement offer, with lender, APR and rate in percent, points, and monthly payment in dollars.

current_monthly_payment.description: What the user pays each month in dollars on this debt today.

current_rate.description: Rate in percent the user currently pays on this debt.

lifetime_savings.description: Total dollars saved over the remaining term, before any refinancing or closing costs.

monthly_savings.description: Dollars per month saved by moving to the best offer at the same balance and remaining term.

product_type.description: Category of the existing debt, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan'.

rank.description: Priority of this debt for refinancing, 1 = largest opportunity.

worth_it.description: True when the saving is large enough to be worth acting on; it does not account for closing costs specific to the user.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

totals.description: Combined opportunity across every debt in the stack.

debts_worth_refinancing.description: How many of the submitted debts cleared the worth-it bar.

total_lifetime_savings.description: Sum of the lifetime savings in dollars across all debts, dominated by the longest-term debt.

total_monthly_savings.description: Sum of the monthly savings in dollars across all debts worth refinancing.
